title: Leaflet template: three panels with heading boxes and a picture box
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 48 (Leaflet template: three panels with heading boxes and a picture box (printable or tablet))
intro: Lesson 48: Writing a leaflet about the Adi people (condensed lesson). Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Panel
Content
rows: Clothing and crafts; a fact box

parts.text: Place adverbial opener: High on the hillsides, Adi families live in bamboo houses.
• raised on stilts to stay dry
• thatched roofs for the heavy rain
• granaries built a little way off

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A short section with a heading, an opener and bullets

panels.title: Accurate and respectful
points: Only facts from the fact sheet

keywords.def: a short sheet that gives information
a dot that starts a short listed fact
a question to make the reader think, not to be answered

questions.q: Turn into a bullet: The Adi weave brightly coloured cloth on looms.
Write a caption for a photo of a cane bridge
questions.a: For example: A cane bridge swings over the Siang river.

questions.q: Write a heading for the farming section
questions.a: For example: Farming on the Slopes

questions.q: Core: write your leaflet: title, three headed sections with bullet points, a rhetorical question and a picture box with a caption
Extend: tick each item on the leaflet checklist
Stretch: add a Did you know? fact box
questions.a: For example: Did you know? Some Adi bridges are made entirely of cane.

questions.q: Which is the best leaflet title?
options: Life in the Misty Hills: Meet the Adi
questions.a: B) Life in the Misty Hills: Meet the Adi. B is eye-catching and tells the reader the topic. A and C are vague.
